families.launcher: POSM multicall ac9650d8, 1,444 bytes (initializePool + MINT_POSITION full range -887272..887272 + SETTLE_PAIR + SWEEP), value 2.0 ETH x13 / 1.8 x3 / 1.5 x1 (exact wei 1999999999999992334, 1799999999999992727, 1499999999999993361, also ...7576/...7700 at tick 200311/201364), liquidity sqrt(value x 1e28 tokens) e.g. L 141421356237309504880168 at tick 223338; a fresh launch wallet per pool (17 wallets for 17 pools, launch nonce 3 in 15, 4 in 2). Same operator also launches the fee-500 ts-10 sibling (5 pools) and did 13 more on Oct 7 (pre-window, fetched: 11 fee 100 + 2 fee 500). families.first_buy: first non-launch buy = the chain-wide dust bot 0xe71a69f4 (2e-6 ETH via UR) at +3 in 17/17. First real (>=0.0002) = outsider 0x5e6ec144 (0.0003 ETH at +85..+98) in 13, the crowd in 4. The SCHEDULED buy = the operator's crowd: Universal Router execute 3593564c, 1,284-byte calldata, sender a brand-new wallet (nonce 0), 16 distinct wallets for 16 pools; first crowd buy at +258/+277/+319/+577/+921 (min/p10/p50/p90/max), size 0.0185/0.0534/0.0971 ETH (p10/50/90, min 0.0072); present in 16/17 (94%). Then exactly 10 crowd buys per pool in 16/16 (33/33 incl. sibling and Oct 7), gaps p10/50/90 96/139/208 blocks, the 10th at +1304..+2367 (p50 1729), totalling 0.4834-0.4894 ETH on 2-ETH pools (0.678-0.683 on 1.8, 0.974 on 1.5): a fixed pump of the price by about +54% (2 ETH) / +90% (1.8) / +170% (1.5). The crowd never sells.
families.pull: 10/17 (58.8%) pulled within 3000 blocks; from launch p10/50/90 1567/2019/2791 (min 663, the crowd-less pool); from the first crowd buy p10/50/90 1450/1746/2472 (min 1309); from the 10th crowd buy min 58, p10 93, p50 291, p90 715 blocks. All by the launch wallet through POSM modifyLiquidities dd46508f, full liquidity. Window union (22): 0.636 within 3000; after the 10th crowd buy min 58 / p10 93 / p50 431.
families.outsiders: Before the first crowd buy: real-size (>=0.0002 ETH) outsiders in 13/17 pools (all Oct 10; 0/5 fee-500 Oct 9, 0/13 Oct 7): 0x5e6ec144 0.0003 ETH at ~+90 in 13 (holds through the crowd, sells at +1766..+1999 for about +40-50%: the hold rule at 1/20 our size), 0x13301ff0 0.0003-0.0005 at +91..+138 in 8 (sells right after the first crowd buy), 0x3155c72d 4e-5, 0xc74d9ced 0.005148 in 1; 0x0b410a5f buys 7e-5 ETH ~13 blocks after the first crowd buy and sells ~80 later in 18 of 22. TRAP TEST: with outsiders (13): crowd came 12/13, pulled<=3000 8/13, pull from launch p10/50/90 1567/2477/2791, pull after the first outsider 1479/2379/2706 blocks; without (22 = 4 fee-100 + 5 fee-500 + 13 Oct 7): crowd came 21/22, pull from launch 1956/2431/2819: no sooner pull after outsiders of <=0.0005 ETH, and a 0.001576 ETH outsider mid-crowd (pool 0x0788f75c) did not stop the crowd. Caveat, n=1: the only outsider of our size before a crowd (0.005148 ETH at +586, in a pool whose crowd had not started) was followed by the pull 77 blocks later (+663) and no crowd; the other crowd-less pool (Oct 7, no outsider at all) was not pulled within 3000 blocks. So 2/35 pools get no crowd regardless; whether a 0.0058 buy before the crowd starts makes the operator abort is untested.
families.front_rule: literal (land +1, sell one block after the first crowd buy, or at +20 if none by then; none comes by +20): n 17, mean -0.09%, median -0.09%, win 0%, pulled-first 0, $-0.014 a trade, $-0.12 a day (8.5/day in the 48 h window). Waiting for the first crowd buy (deadline +600): n 17, mean +4.55%, median +3.56%, win 94%, pulled-first 0, $+0.682 a trade, $+5.80 a day (8.5/day in the 48 h window). FAMILY RULE (land +1, sell one block after the 10th crowd buy; no crowd buy by +640: sell at +640; deadline +2400): n 17, mean +60.85%, median +54.49%, win 94%, pulled-first 0, $+9.128 a trade, $+77.61 a day (8.5/day in the 48 h window) (median hold ~1,730 blocks = 3 min; two pools hit the +640 abort: the crowd-less one sold at +0.45%, 23 blocks before its pull at +663, and the one whose crowd started late at +921 sold at -0.05%, the only loser). Stake sweep, same rule: 0.02 ETH +60.0%, 0.05 ETH +58.2%, 0.1 ETH +55.5% ($143 a trade).
families.follow_rule: literal (buy one block after the first buy >=0.0002 = 0x5e6ec144's 0.0003 at ~+90 in 13 pools / the first crowd buy in 4; sell one block after the next real buy or at buy+4; the next buy is always >4 blocks away): n 17, mean -0.09%, median -0.09%, win 0%, pulled-first 0, $-0.014 a trade, $-0.12 a day (8.5/day in the 48 h window). Follow-entry with the family exit (buy one block after the FIRST CROWD buy, sell one block after the 10th): n 16, mean +59.82%, median +49.58%, win 100%, pulled-first 0, $+8.973 a trade, $+71.80 a day (8.0/day in the 48 h window) (never enters a crowd-less pool).
families.capacity: minOut DECODED from the crowd's UR calldata (V4_SWAP SWAP_EXACT_IN: the word after amountIn = tx value is amountOutMinimum; word 22 of the 1,284-byte layout): minOut = 0.800 x its own fill in 16/16 (a fresh quote at send time with 20% slippage; minOut / launch-state quote 0.7994-0.8000). Real slack: 0.218/0.239/0.241 ETH (p10/50/90, min 0.179) can sit ahead of the first crowd buy before it reverts; under the schema's 1%-of-launch-quote assumption it would be 0.0093/0.0102/0.0103 ETH, but the quote is fresh, so our buy 250+ blocks earlier is inside it. No crowd buy is dropped in any replay up to a 0.1 ETH stake.
families.engine_config: recognizer: tx to POSM 0x58daec3116aae6d93017baaea7749052e8a04fa7, selector ac9650d8, calldata 1,444 bytes (the decode_launch layout), value 1.5-2.0 ETH (not 2.4333285), decoded PoolKey currency0 0, fee 100 ts 1 or fee 500 ts 10, hooks 0, MINT_POSITION -887272..887272; launch wallet nonce 3-4. Eligibility: L0 = sqrt(value x 1e28 or 1e27). Fire: any block from launch to ~+180 (nobody but the dust bot and tiny outsiders buys before +188; landing at +1 prices the same). Exit trigger: count crowd buys in the feed: tx to Universal Router 0x8876789976decbfcbbbe364623c63652db8c0904, execute 3593564c, 1,284-byte calldata, sender nonce 0, value 0.007-0.19 ETH, path through this pool's token; sell in the block after the 10th; abort (sell) at +640 if no crowd buy yet; hard deadline +2400; also sell at once on any modifyLiquidities (dd46508f) from the launch wallet. Hold 1,200-2,400 blocks (2-4 min): needs its own position slot (front's one slot would be blocked). Safer entry variant: buy one block after the first crowd buy (same exit).
families.notes: candidate_score = the family rule (front, exit after the 10th crowd buy) at $15 on this strict family's 17 launches = $77.61/day; the literal front/follow rules are flat because the schedule runs at +258..+2367, not +7..+10. The operator as a whole in the window (fee 100 + fee 500, 22 launches, 11/day): n 22, mean +60.82%, median +54.19%, win 95%, pulled-first 0, $+9.123 a trade, $+100.38 a day (11.0/day in the 48 h window); with the 13 Oct 7 pools (35): mean +59.2%, median +53.9%, 32/35 up, 0 pulled-first; each session separately +56% (Oct 7), +61% (Oct 9-10 fee 100), +61% (fee 500). Pricer calibration: v2.433 front in the live window Oct 10 09:08-11:40 replays +13.98% mean on 409 pools (live record +14.1%); operator A follow +4.3% (handoff +2-4%). Risks: (1) 2/35 pools get no crowd (one pulled at +663 after a 0.005 ETH outside buy: the abort at +640 exits both); (2) the reaction to a buy of our size before the crowd is untested (n=1, above); (3) small competitors already run this (0x5e6ec144 hold, 0x13301ff0 front, 0x0b410a5f follow) and the operator tolerates them; (4) launches come in irregular sessions (3 sessions in 4 days), so $/day is session-dependent. Price/volume per pool is small (0.48 ETH crowd per 2-ETH pool), but the trade is not capacity-bound below ~0.1 ETH. Scripts and data: analyse_5/analyse.py, pricer.py, opc_timeline.py (every swap's tx: opc_txs.json), fetch_hist*.py + hist_build.py (Oct 7 pools), results.json, calib.json.
